description: Skills and an MCP server for building with Mapbox. The skills cover integration patterns for web, iOS,  Android, and Flutter, along with map styling, cartography, search, and geospatial operations. The MCP server connects your AI agent to live Mapbox data: geocoding, routing, and isochrones, so it can build real maps and location features using current, accurate data.
